feature-workflow.trigger: The /feature command, or any approved ticket in NEXT_TASK.md with no unresolved architectural ambiguity.
agents: chief-architect — only if an architectural question arises
backend-engineer and/or frontend-engineer and/or infrastructure-engineer and/or finance-engineer — implementation via api-workflow/ui-workflow
git-engineer — only if the user explicitly requests a commit
inputs: files directly related to the feature
outputs: modified or new files implementing exactly one approved feature
stop_conditions: Acceptance criteria satisfied → stop and report
Feature requires an architectural decision → stop, report, wait for Chief Systems Architect
Ticket is ambiguous or missing acceptance criteria → stop, route back to product-manager
feature-workflow.verification: qa-engineer runs the relevant build and exercises the golden path directly, not a static read of the diff.

api-workflow.trigger: feature-workflow (or /bug) determines the change is scoped to apps/marcos-api/.
agents: backend-engineer — implements the endpoint(s)/logic per the approved spec
qa-engineer — verifies with a real server run and real HTTP requests
outputs: modified or new files under apps/marcos-api/ only
stop_conditions: Spec requires a new database, auth mechanism, or dependency not already approved → stop, escalate to chief-architect
Change would touch apps/marcos-core/ without explicit assignment → stop
Endpoint behaves as specified and is verified → proceed to parent workflow's documentation step
api-workflow.verification: Start uvicorn, issue real HTTP requests against every changed/new endpoint, confirm responses match spec; stop server afterward unless told to leave it running.

ui-workflow.trigger: feature-workflow (or /bug) determines the change is scoped to apps/marcos-dashboard/.
agents: frontend-engineer — implements the view(s)/component(s) per the approved spec
qa-engineer — verifies via a running dev server and in-browser check
outputs: modified or new files under apps/marcos-dashboard/ only
stop_conditions: Spec requires wiring to apps/marcos-api/ without explicit approval → stop, escalate to chief-architect
Spec requires a new UI/state library outside Tailwind + base-ui → stop and escalate
Feature builds and is visually confirmed working → proceed to parent workflow's documentation step
ui-workflow.verification: npm run build succeeds, then dev server run with golden path and edge cases exercised in-browser. A passing build alone is not verification.

bug-workflow.trigger: The /bug command, or a defect reported in a currently running service.
agents: qa-engineer — reproduces the reported failure before any code changes
backend-engineer or frontend-engineer — implements the minimal root-cause fix via api-workflow/ui-workflow
qa-engineer — confirms the fix by rerunning the original failing scenario
documentation-engineer — updates PROJECT_STATE.md Known Issues only if tracked there
inputs: PROJECT_STATE.md Known Issues section, if relevant
outputs: a minimal fix scoped to the reported defect — no unrelated refactor
stop_conditions: Failure cannot be reproduced → stop and report
Root cause implies an architecture change → stop, escalate to chief-architect
Original failing scenario no longer fails → stop and report
bug-workflow.verification: Rerun the exact scenario that originally reproduced the bug and confirm it now passes, plus a quick adjacent-behavior check.
